name: pinpoint
description: Browser extension + native host: annotate regions on any page and hand the batch to a coding agent.

scripts.lint: npm run build -- firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.test: npm run build && node native-host/test-host.mjs && node test/overlay.test.mjs && node test/chrome-load.test.mjs && node test/ui-shots.mjs
scripts.test:chrome: npm run build -- chrome && node test/chrome-load.test.mjs
